title: Carve 0.2 smart punctuation runs
description: The fixed runs of characters that smart typography replaces, and the similar runs the chapter names as text. The longest match is taken. Quotes and hyphen runs follow rules that are not table-shaped (C2-I-104 to C2-I-112). `runs` is sorted by `source`, `quotes` and `dashes` by `kind`.
